description: Queries the isolated read-only market intelligence snapshot for any FX, metal, commodity, crypto, or index instrument and returns both a regulatory-compliant analysis and an interactive MCP App visualization frame (order book trapped crowd histogram, macro causal transmission graph, and regime entropy sparkline).

default_symbol.description: Instrument code if not explicitly named in query (e.g., 'XAU_USD', 'EUR_USD', 'USD_JPY')

format.description: Output payload format: 'full' includes LLM narrative markdown and ui:// interactive resource (1.0 CU); 'json_compact' returns raw deterministic JSON telemetry (0.1 CU).

query.description: Natural language market intelligence query (e.g., 'Where are retail traders trapped on Gold?')

use_llm.description: Whether to use LLM synthesis (default true) or deterministic institutional summary

name: render_market_intelligence_frame
